title: The Best of Squamish Tour from Vancouver
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off (select Vancouver & Richmond hotels only, please call to arrange)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Suggested clothing: comfortable clothes for the day including a warm shirt or outer layer
Snacks are available for purchase at Sea to Sky Gondola and Squamish Canyon
PICKUP TIMES VARY DEPENDING ON WHERE YOU ARE STAYING. PLEASE CONTACT YOUR TOUR OPERATOR FOR YOUR EXACT PICKUP TIME.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the ultimate Pacific Northwest adventure with The Best of Squamish, a curated 7.5-hour journey through the crown jewels of the Sea-to-Sky corridor. Your day features a soaring ascent on the Sea to Sky Gondola for breathtaking alpine views, followed by an immersive rainforest walk through the stunning Squamish Canyon. Explore the depths of the historic Britannia Mine Museum before a seamless return to the city. It is the definitive way to experience the mountains, the forest, and coastal history in one comprehensive, guided excursion.
